sentences.text:
... Pet
 Versus
 1. The State of Bihar.

2. Yamuna Devi, wife of Harinath Jha, resident of vilalge Korthu, P.S.
 Ghanshyampur, District Darbhanga, at present, Yamuna Devi, D/o-
 Bishwanath Jha, resident of village Majaura, P.S. Bahera, District Darb
 ... ... Opposite 
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Sameer Ranjan
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Nirmal Kumar Sinha
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State but in spite of putting appearance through vakalatnama none is present on behalf of opposite party no.2.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498A, 406, 386 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.

Petitioner has neither made any dowry Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.43009 of 2022(3) dt.16-01-2024 demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.

The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar,
reported in 2006 (3) PLJR 182.
5.
